name: GET /redirectUrl?code=...&state=... posts the authorization_code grant (client secret in body) and redirects to onCompleteRedirectTo with authorizationStatus=0

source.reference: oauth2-authorization-code-using-the-HTTP-connector/src/main/app/http-authorization-code-web.xml; Mule 3.8 AutoAuthorizationCodeTokenRequestHandler#callTokenUrl form: code, client_id, client_secret, grant_type=authorization_code, redirect_uri (POST, no Authorization header); success → 'Successfully retrieved access token', SUCCESS status 0, 302 to onCompleteRedirectTo?authorizationStatus=0
